correctness.rationale: The exact D4 root graph is 8-regular with 96 edges. Each edge belongs to exactly one of eight induced K_{2,2,2} octahedra; pair-spin sums give the universal -4J local lower bound with an equality criterion. Three explicit perfect-matching spin assignments reach global -32J, so simultaneous local minima characterize all ground states. The 2^24 finite masks are completely enumerated in exact integers twice: once by the original Hamiltonian in Gray-code order and independently by local equality conditions; both yield M-polynomial coefficients 948, 672, 264, 48, 3 and total 2922. Full source path verify_24cell_ising.cpp was compiled and executed. This is a finite exhaustive proof, not an extrapolation.

originality.rationale: A closely relevant published same-graph theorem already tabulates the independent-set face vector and is explicitly credited. Its statement, proof and exact numbers do not assert or entail the full zero-field Ising maximizing-cut multiplicities at all magnetizations. The focal 2015 paper studies other frustrated lattice graphs. No stronger covering Ising/cut polynomial result emerged from the actual published-finding corpus, primary source and web comparisons; specialist priority remains a documented risk. The accessible 2022 same-polytope spin paper instead specifies a continuous preferred-twist Hamiltonian, and the full text remains an explicit access limitation.
residual_risks: An uncatalogued exact graph-Ising or maximum-cut table could already encode the same magnetization polynomial.
A general structural identity for this root graph might imply the result from stronger known invariants even though no such implication was identified.
Published independent-set counts already cover the extremal 8-spin minority configurations; those counts are explicitly excluded as standalone novelty.

The 2022 same-polytope continuous-spin article was only available by author abstract, not full text; a hidden side remark on the binary Ising case cannot be ruled out, although the specified model differs.

value.rationale: Zero-field degeneracy and magnetization resolution are natural ground-state observables on the highly symmetric, frustrated 4D 24-cell lattice graph. The eight local-octahedron coexistence constraints are a structural energy characterization and explain the exact finite entropy and 2922-state multiplicity, beyond the already published independent-set face count. The finite fact is mathematically motivated and reusable, not an arbitrary numerical slice or a claimed thermodynamic phase transition.
